therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Androgen signaling inhibition in prostate cancer cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Men with adenocarcinoma of the prostate receiving salvage radiation therapy post-prostatectomy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Freedom from PSA progression at 2 years

results.effect_size: 84% vs 66% freedom from PSA progression at 2 years
biomarker_changes: PSA progression rates differed between arms
safety_signals: Higher treatment-related symptoms in enzalutamide arm
Worse sexual function scores in enzalutamide arm
Lower quality of life scores in some domains with enzalutamide
results.dose_information: Enzalutamide 160 mg PO once daily for 6 months (2 months prior to SRT, 2 months during SRT, 2 months following SRT)
